## Surfaces

The canvas, then the surfaces content sits on, in light and dark.

## Status colours in use

Each status label always gets the same colour, with its dot, so colour is never the only cue. The ratio is the status colour on its subtle fill, computed from the tokens.

## The five answers

| Question | Answer | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Which color roles does it need? | Surface, text, action and status | Reading needs few color roles. |
| How many emphasis levels do actions need? | Three | Primary, secondary and a text link. |
| How is the palette defined? | Neutrals and one brand ramp | Warm paper neutrals and one ink ramp. |
| How saturated is the palette? | Balanced | A calm, balanced palette. |
| Where does color carry meaning first? | Links and actions | Color marks links inside the text. |

| `color.category.5.@` | `content-first.theme.light.color.category.5.@` → `color.neutral.500` → `content-first.theme.light.color.neutral.500` → `color.stone.light.500` | `content-first.theme.dark.color.category.5.@` → `color.neutral.700` → `content-first.theme.dark.color.neutral.700` → `color.stone.dark.700` |
| `color.category.5.subtle` | `content-first.theme.light.color.category.5.subtle` → `color.neutral.100` → `content-first.theme.light.color.neutral.100` → `color.stone.light.100` | `content-first.theme.dark.color.category.5.subtle` → `color.neutral.100` → `content-first.theme.dark.color.neutral.100` → `color.stone.dark.100` |
| `color.disabled.text` | `content-first.theme.light.color.disabled.text` → `color.neutral.500` → `content-first.theme.light.color.neutral.500` → `color.stone.light.500` | `content-first.theme.dark.color.disabled.text` → `color.neutral.500` → `content-first.theme.dark.color.neutral.500` → `color.stone.dark.500` |
| `color.disabled.surface` | `content-first.theme.light.color.disabled.surface` → `color.neutral.100` → `content-first.theme.light.color.neutral.100` → `color.stone.light.100` | `content-first.theme.dark.color.disabled.surface` → `color.neutral.100` → `content-first.theme.dark.color.neutral.100` → `color.stone.dark.100` |
| `color.disabled.border` | `content-first.theme.light.color.disabled.border` → `color.neutral.200` → `content-first.theme.light.color.neutral.200` → `color.stone.light.200` | `content-first.theme.dark.color.disabled.border` → `color.neutral.200` → `content-first.theme.dark.color.neutral.200` → `color.stone.dark.200` |

The raw values these tokens end at are on [Primitives › Color](../primitives/color).

## Where it lands

- Button
- Input
- Control
- Badge
- Card
- Table
- Tabs
- Overlay

## When to use what

| Situation | Use | Not | Why |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A selected row or item | color.surface.selected | Bold text only | A tint shows the choice clearly on warm paper. |
| An error message | color.status.danger and a plain sentence | Color alone | The sentence says what to fix; color only draws the eye. |
| A link | color.text.link, underlined | Color without underline | Readers expect links to be underlined inside text. |
| A status | Badge pill with a word | An icon alone | Status is rare; a word is clear. |
| The action that completes the task | Button primary, one per section | Two primaries side by side | One clear action per section. |
| An alternative or cancel | Button ghost as a text link | A second boxed button | A link feels lighter and does not compete. |
| Delete or remove | Button secondary with the full verb, then confirm with Button danger | Button primary | Naming the verb and confirming prevents a mistake. |

## Status urgency

Status colours go up in urgency: info, then warning, then danger. Pick the level that matches the real risk. Never go up a level to get attention. Success sits outside the order.

`color.status.info.@` → `color.status.warning.@` → `color.status.danger.@`

## Pairs at a glance

Which colour may sit on which fill, and the contrast it keeps there in every brand and mode. Text pairs by tone: every fill says whether it is light or dark, and the text on it is `color.text.on-light` or `color.text.on-dark`. The page's own text is the set of its own surfaces. The harness checks every pair.

| --- | --- | --- |
| `color.text.primary` | The page's own fills: `color.surface.canvas`, `color.surface.default`, `color.surface.raised`, `color.surface.sunken`, `color.surface.selected`, `color.surface.inverse`, `color.action.primary.@`, `color.action.primary.hover`, `color.action.danger.@`, `color.action.danger.hover`, `color.action.secondary.@`, `color.action.secondary.hover`, `color.status.info.subtle`, `color.status.warning.subtle`, `color.status.danger.subtle`, `color.status.success.subtle` | 4.5:1 |

| `color.text.inverse` | `color.surface.inverse` | 4.5:1 |
| `color.text.on-light` | Fills whose tone is light: `color.surface.canvas`, `color.surface.default`, `color.surface.raised`, `color.surface.sunken`, `color.surface.selected`, `color.surface.inverse`, `color.action.primary.@`, `color.action.primary.hover`, `color.action.danger.@`, `color.action.danger.hover`, `color.action.secondary.@`, `color.action.secondary.hover`, `color.status.info.subtle`, `color.status.warning.subtle`, `color.status.danger.subtle`, `color.status.success.subtle` | 4.5:1 |

## The tone of each fill

Every fill says whether it is light or dark. Text on it is `color.text.on-light` on a light fill, `color.text.on-dark` on a dark one. "Everything" means text.primary, text.secondary, text.muted, link, icon, border, focus, text.info, text.success, text.warning, text.danger.

| Fill | Light mode | Dark mode | What sits on it |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `color.surface.canvas` | light | dark | text.primary, text.secondary, text.muted, link, icon, border, focus |
| `color.surface.default` | light | dark | text.primary, text.secondary, text.muted, link, icon, border, focus |
| `color.surface.raised` | light | dark | text.primary, text.secondary, text.muted, link, icon, border, focus |
| `color.surface.sunken` | light | dark | text.primary, text.secondary, text.muted, link, icon, border, focus |
| `color.surface.selected` | light | dark | text.primary, text.secondary, text.muted, link, icon, border, focus |
| `color.surface.inverse` | dark | light | text.primary, icon, focus |
| `color.action.primary.@` | dark | light | text.primary |
| `color.action.primary.hover` | dark | light | text.primary |
| `color.action.danger.@` | dark | light | text.primary |
| `color.action.danger.hover` | dark | light | text.primary |
| `color.action.secondary.@` | light | dark | text.primary, icon |
| `color.action.secondary.hover` | light | dark | text.primary, icon |
| `color.status.info.subtle` | light | dark | text.primary, icon, text.info |
| `color.status.warning.subtle` | light | dark | text.primary, icon, text.warning |
| `color.status.danger.subtle` | light | dark | text.primary, icon, text.danger |
| `color.status.success.subtle` | light | dark | text.primary, icon, text.success |
